name: surface
description: Scan files and payloads for malware and prompt-injection threats using the Surface API.
long_description: Surface Security Scanner is a Model Context Protocol server that lets your AI assistant scan files and text payloads for malware, IOCs, and prompt-injection attacks through the Surface API. On clients that support the MCP Apps extension, scan results render as an interactive card with a proceed/block gate; everywhere else the same results appear as text. Configure your Surface API key and (optionally) a custom base URL to point at a self-hosted or local Surface instance.

surface_key.title: Surface API Key
surface_key.description: Your Surface API key. Stored securely in the OS keychain, never in plaintext config.

surface_base_url.title: Surface Base URL
surface_base_url.description: Surface API base URL. Override to point at a local or self-hosted instance, e.g. http://localhost:8085/api

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a file for malware and threats.

tools.name: scan_payload
tools.description: Scan a raw text or binary payload for threats.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Poll a deferred scan by ID.

tools.name: get_scan_detail
tools.description: Get full findings for a historical scan.
